title: The Battle Belongs to the Lord

request.style: English, female solo voice, powerful and clear, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft drums, uplifting and heroic mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A champion rose from the camp of the foe
Goliath from Gath with a bronze coat
Six cubits and a span he stood tall
With a spear like a weaver's beam wall
He shouted out to the ranks of Israel
Defying the armies of the living God

[Chorus]
You come with sword and spear and javelin
But I come in the name of the Lord
The battle belongs to the Lord alone
He will hand you over to the one

[Verse]
For forty days he came morning and night
Taunting the soldiers in the light
Saul and the people were shaken with fear
But a young shepherd was drawing near
He had faced lions and bears in the field
And rescued the lamb with strength revealed

[Pre-Chorus]
Your servant has killed both lion and bear
This uncircumcised Philistine is there
He defied the armies of the living God
Who rescues me from the paw's hold

[Chorus]
You come with sword and spear and javelin
But I come in the name of the Lord
The battle belongs to the Lord alone
He will hand you over to the one

[Verse]
David reached into his bag for a stone
Slung it hard at the giant's throne
The stone sank into his forehead deep
And the giant fell to the ground in sleep
David took the sword from the sheath
Cut off the head in the heat of death

[Chorus]
You come with sword and spear and javelin
But I come in the name of the Lord
The battle belongs to the Lord alone
He will hand you over to the one

[Bridge]
Then the whole earth will know that Israel has a God
And all gathered here will know the Lord is good
He does not save with sword or spear
But the battle belongs to the one who is here

[Outro]
The Philistines fled when their hero was gone
David stood triumphed over the one
The battle belongs to the Lord
